text:
AFTERLIFE INC.
Exploration & Reclamation Division
Operated in partnership with CentroCom

OVERSEER RECRUITMENT OFFER

Congratulations.

If you are reading this, you have been identified as a potential candidate for AfterLife Inc.'s pioneering new Exploration & Reclamation Division, an ambitious initiative dedicated to restoring permanent human habitation in regions currently classified as:

- abandoned,
- compromised,
- overrun,
- structurally unstable,
- biologically unfavorable,
- or "probably fine from a distance."

As an Overseer, you will be entrusted with the establishment, management, and long-term development of a new regional outpost under CentroCom supervision.

This is a unique opportunity to become part of the next chapter of human civilization.
Possibly the last chapter.
But preferably not.
title: Dear Applicant,

text:
As an Overseer, you will be responsible for directing a small deployment team into an assigned reclamation zone and transforming an initial survival camp into a stable, productive, defensible population center.

Your responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:
- managing personnel,
- assigning work,
- securing food,
- organizing shelter,
- allocating scarce resources,
- constructing infrastructure,
- coordinating defense,
- overseeing medical response,
- recruiting additional survivors,
- conducting expeditions,
- recovering useful materials,
- establishing trade,
- maintaining morale through competent leadership,
- responding to unexpected emergencies,
- responding to expected emergencies that remain inconvenient,
- and determining which emergencies can reasonably be ignored until morning.

Successful Overseers may eventually qualify their assigned territory for permanent settlement status.
Exceptional Overseers may even oversee the development of a functioning town.
AfterLife Inc. recognizes that this may sound ambitious.
That is why we have described it as pioneering.
title: YOUR ROLE

text:
You will not be undertaking this mission alone.
Every Overseer receives access to a company-issued SeerPad, providing centralized control over approved settlement functions.

Depending on operational authorization, your SeerPad may provide access to:
- personnel management,
- construction,
- inventory tracking,
- resource monitoring,
- communications,
- task management,
- defensive coordination,
- recruitment,
- regional intelligence,
- expedition planning,
- trade,
- research,
- municipal development,
- and additional systems CentroCom determines you have earned the right to know about.

Access to certain features may be withheld until your outpost demonstrates sufficient operational stability.
This is not intended as a lack of trust.
It is intended as a controlled rollout.
title: YOUR SUPPORT

text:
CentroCom will provide remote operational guidance throughout your assignment.
You may periodically receive:
- objectives,
- milestone evaluations,
- construction authorizations,
- resource advisories,
- regional warnings,
- personnel notices,
- congratulatory messages,
- strongly worded recommendations,
- and automatically generated expressions of concern.

CentroCom is committed to supporting Overseers in the field.
Please note that "supporting" refers primarily to informational, administrative, and motivational assistance.
Physical assistance may not be available.
Timely physical assistance should not be assumed.
Extraction should not be assumed.
title: CENTROCOM OVERSIGHT

text:
Upon acceptance, you will be assigned:
- a small crew of survivors,
- temporary shelter,
- basic food reserves,
- limited ammunition,
- construction materials,
- medical supplies,
- basic tools,
- and a reasonable expectation that additional resources exist somewhere nearby.

Your deployment zone will be selected using CentroCom regional analysis.
While every effort is made to identify suitable locations, AfterLife Inc. cannot guarantee:
- reliable water,
- intact infrastructure,
- favorable weather,
- nearby farmland,
- accessible roads,
- friendly neighbors,
- functional utilities,
- available medical facilities,
- predictable infected behavior,
- or the continued existence of anything shown on pre-collapse maps.

Historical data may be inaccurate due to time, damage, population displacement, structural decay, fire, flooding, abandonment, infected migration, human interference, clerical error, or events classified internally as "other."
title: INITIAL DEPLOYMENT PACKAGE

text:
Your assigned region may contain individuals currently categorized as infected.
For clarity, the term "infected" may include persons who are:
- actively hostile,
- recently deceased,
- previously deceased,
- mobile despite previous death,
- apparently inactive,
- temporarily inactive,
- partially dismembered,
- difficult to classify,
- or behaving in a manner inconsistent with accepted biological expectations.

Overseers are advised not to approach infected persons unless necessary.
If approach is necessary, CentroCom recommends maintaining a safe distance.
If maintaining a safe distance is no longer possible, CentroCom recommends resolving the situation.
How you resolve the situation is left to your professional judgment.
title: INFECTED PERSONS

text:
Your deployment personnel are considered essential operational assets and, where practical, human beings.
You are expected to provide reasonable access to:
- food,
- shelter,
- medical attention,
- safety,
- meaningful work,
- and opportunities not to be bitten.

You may recruit additional survivors as your outpost develops.
Each additional survivor may increase:
- labor capacity,
- defensive capability,
- expedition potential,
- food consumption,
- housing demand,
- medical burden,
- and the statistical likelihood of somebody making a poor decision while unsupervised.

Recruitment is therefore encouraged responsibly.
AfterLife Inc. assumes no liability for disputes arising from personality conflicts, romantic entanglements, workplace disagreements, ration allocation, snoring, theft accusations, questionable cooking, or disputes beginning with the phrase:
> "I thought you said you checked the door."
title: PERSONNEL MANAGEMENT

text:
At later stages of development, Overseers may be authorized to conduct scavenging operations and expeditions outside the established outpost.
Potential objectives may include:
- resource recovery,
- survivor rescue,
- reconnaissance,
- infrastructure repair,
- regional security,
- communications restoration,
- trade contact,
- supply retrieval,
- investigation of unusual activity,
- and entering buildings everybody agrees are probably a bad idea.

All field operations carry risk.
CentroCom will provide available intelligence where possible.
Intelligence should not be interpreted as certainty.
Threat assessments may change without notice.
Structures marked "clear" may no longer be clear.
Individuals marked "friendly" may no longer be friendly.
Roads marked "passable" may technically remain roads.
title: FIELD OPERATIONS

text:
In reclamation zones, property abandoned during regional collapse may be recovered for settlement use where no active claimant can reasonably be identified.
This includes, but is not limited to:
- lumber,
- metal,
- food,
- ammunition,
- tools,
- equipment,
- vehicles,
- medical supplies,
- machinery,
- building materials,
- and items sitting unattended for what appears to have been a very long time.

AfterLife Inc. encourages Overseers to exercise discretion when determining whether property is genuinely abandoned.
A person shouting:
> "Hey, that's mine!"
should generally be considered evidence that the property may not be abandoned.
title: RESOURCE OWNERSHIP

text:
Overseers are expected to develop increasingly permanent infrastructure as regional stability improves.
Early structures may include temporary shelters, work stations, basic food production, and defensive positions.
Permanent construction authorization may be granted after CentroCom determines that your outpost demonstrates sufficient:
- population stability,
- food production,
- medical capability,
- defensive readiness,
- resource access,
- operational competence,
- and continued existence.

Please note that permanent construction does not indicate permanent safety.
Buildings may be damaged by:
- infected activity,
- human activity,
- fire,
- weather,
- structural failure,
- poor maintenance,
- resource shortages,
- operational mistakes,
- or exceptionally determined wildlife.
title: STRUCTURAL DEVELOPMENT

text:
AfterLife Inc. recognizes that reclamation operations may result in injury or loss of life.
Every reasonable effort should be made to protect assigned personnel.
However, by participating in the Exploration & Reclamation Division, you acknowledge that absolute safety cannot be guaranteed.

Potential causes of injury or death include:
- infected attack,
- blood loss,
- untreated wounds,
- structural collapse,
- fire,
- environmental exposure,
- hostile survivors,
- accidents,
- equipment malfunction,
- inadequate preparation,
- overconfidence,
- underconfidence,
- unexplored basements,
- suspiciously quiet hallways,
- and investigating noises that clearly should have been left alone.

In the event of personnel loss, Overseers are expected to adjust staffing accordingly.
CentroCom may offer condolences where system availability permits.
title: CASUALTY POLICY

text:
Regional infected populations may periodically form large migratory groups.
These events may occur:
- with warning,
- with insufficient warning,
- without warning,
- immediately after you commit most of your personnel elsewhere,
- or while you are attempting to accomplish something unrelated.

Overseers are authorized to determine the appropriate response.
Options may include:
- direct engagement,
- fortified defense,
- withdrawal,
- sheltering personnel,
- reducing settlement activity,
- waiting quietly,
- and hoping the infected continue walking.

AfterLife Inc. does not consider avoidance to be cowardice.
Current terminology is:
strategic non-engagement.
title: HORDE CONDITIONS

text:
Your SeerPad will serve as your primary link to CentroCom.
Loss of SeerPad functionality may significantly impair your ability to manage settlement systems.
Please avoid:
- dropping the device,
- submerging the device,
- exposing the device to open flame,
- using the device as a weapon,
- allowing infected persons to handle the device,
- or attempting unauthorized repair with scavenged kitchen appliances.

If your SeerPad displays an error message stating:
CONTACT CENTROCOM SUPPORT
and communication with CentroCom is unavailable, please appreciate the irony privately and continue operations to the best of your ability.
title: COMMUNICATIONS

text:
Acceptance of this offer grants you the provisional title:
OVERSEER

Your employment status remains contingent upon continued performance, operational viability, regional conditions, corporate restructuring, communications continuity, and your continued ability to respond to messages.
Extended failure to respond may result in your status being changed to:
INACTIVE

Additional classifications may include:
MISSING
UNREACHABLE
PRESUMED LOST
CONFIRMED LOST
ADMINISTRATIVE REVIEW PENDING

AfterLife Inc. reserves the right to amend terminology in the interest of clarity, morale, or quarterly reporting.
title: EMPLOYMENT STATUS

text:
Qualified Overseers receive:
- leadership authority over assigned reclamation operations,
- access to CentroCom systems,
- deployment housing,
- field supplies,
- professional development opportunities,
- exposure to diverse working environments,
- direct involvement in rebuilding civilization,
- and a sense of accomplishment not currently available through most conventional employment.

Medical coverage is provided primarily through whatever medical infrastructure you successfully establish.
Paid leave is not currently available.
Vacation requests may be reconsidered once the region is no longer actively collapsing.
title: BENEFITS

text:
Participation in the Exploration & Reclamation Division is voluntary.
By accepting this offer, you acknowledge that you understand the associated risks and agree to assume responsibility for regional settlement operations.

You additionally acknowledge that:
- information may be incomplete,
- conditions may deteriorate,
- assigned personnel may be injured,
- resources may become scarce,
- infected populations may migrate,
- assistance may be delayed,
- plans may fail,
- backup plans may also fail,
- and circumstances may arise for which CentroCom has prepared a reassuring message but no practical solution.

You agree to exercise reasonable judgment.
Where reasonable judgment is unavailable, you agree to exercise whatever judgment remains.
title: VOLUNTARY ACCEPTANCE

text:
By selecting I AGREE, you confirm that you have:
- read,
- reviewed,
- skimmed,
- scrolled past,
- or otherwise progressed through
the terms above.

You further acknowledge that selecting I AGREE constitutes acceptance regardless of whether you fully understood every provision.
That sentence has been reviewed by Legal.
Several times.
title: FINAL ACKNOWLEDGMENT

text: I accept appointment as an AfterLife Inc. Overseer and authorize CentroCom to assign me to an available reclamation region.
APPLICATION STATUS: ACCEPTED

Congratulations, Overseer.

Your application to the AfterLife Inc. Exploration & Reclamation Division has been approved.
CentroCom is now preparing your regional deployment.
Please remain available for immediate relocation.
Personal belongings should be limited to essential items.
Sentimental attachment to current surroundings is discouraged.
